title: W021.5 CTO Directive 143 Defect & Remediation Ledger
governingAuthority: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.6 / Rule IV-001 Non-Self-Acceptance

defects.title: Mode B Staging Executor Sent Metadata & Counts Instead of Full Source Rows
defects.rootCause: Directive 142 Mode B executor called RPC stubs sending chunk counts, seat counts, and conflict strings instead of transmitting the actual row records. Status 200 was accepted without real database effects.
remediationActions: Implemented Approach A (Direct PostgREST Upserts) across all 4 criteria.

Stage 1 (CRIT-C02-02): Submits full row arrays to 8 PostgREST endpoints (datasets: 1, dataset_versions: 1, provenance_records: 1, political_organizations: 107, organization_relationships: 10, organization_multilingual_names: 27, organization_symbols: 19, organization_aliases: 1,043 = 1,209 total rows) with on_conflict=id.
Stage 2 (CRIT-D02-02): Submits all 11,298 unique candidate rows to /rest/v1/candidacies with on_conflict=person_id,election_year,election_type,constituency_id.
Stage 3 (CRIT-E01-02): Submits all 4,123 statutory demographic seat rows to /rest/v1/constituency_demographics with on_conflict=constituency_id,election_year.
Stage 4 (CRIT-F02-03): Submits all 2,243 statutory historical election results rows to /rest/v1/election_results with on_conflict=election_id,constituency_id.
Set Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates,return=representation and derived rowsAffected directly from returned row array length.

defects.title: Mock Tests Accepted count: 1 Response While Asserting Thousands of Rows Affected
defects.rootCause: Test harness returned { success: true, count: 1 } and executor assigned hard-coded rowsAffected, masking execution failure.
remediationActions: Rebuilt tests/staging-execution-mode-b.test.mjs to enforce exact row array verification.
Added fail-closed ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH check: throws STAGE_X_ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH if returned row count !== expected row count.
Added fail-closed SEMANTIC_ERROR check: rejects HTTP 200 responses containing database error objects.
Added fail-closed MALFORMED_RESPONSE check: rejects non-JSON responses (HTML, broken syntax).
Mock transport in successful test echoes full payload array, verifying 11 PostgREST calls with correct headers, conflict targets, and payload counts.

defects.title: Plan Digest Checked Only Truthiness Without Exact Canonical Computation
defects.rootCause: Directive 142 verifier only checked Boolean(payload.plan_digest) and skipped exact comparison against the requested payload.
remediationActions: Created scripts/lib/stagingExecutionPlan.mjs implementing generateCanonicalExecutionPlan() and computeExecutionPlanDigest().
Computes 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest over the canonical representation of all 4 stages and their source artifact hashes.
Verifier enforces plan_digest format (64-char lowercase hex) and compares token claim against computed digest, failing closed with PLAN_DIGEST_MISMATCH on discrepancy.

defects.title: Time Claims Permitted Optional iat, Unverified Clock Skew, and Contradictory nbf
defects.rootCause: Verifier treated iat as optional, did not check for future issuance, permitted contradictory nbf (nbf > exp or nbf < iat), and allowed excessive token lifetime.
remediationActions: Enforced mandatory positive integer iat; rejects missing/invalid iat with INVALID_IAT.
Enforced future issuance check with 60-second clock skew tolerance (TOKEN_ISSUED_IN_FUTURE).
Enforced exp > iat check (INVALID_EXPIRY_BEFORE_ISSUANCE).
Enforced nbf <= exp (CONTRADICTORY_TIME_CLAIMS) and nbf >= iat - 60s (INCONSISTENT_TIME_CLAIMS).
Enforced maximum token lifetime <= 3,600s against both iat and nbf (EXCESSIVE_TOKEN_LIFETIME).

defects.title: Operation Grants Did Not Proactively Reject Prohibited Destructive Operations
defects.rootCause: Verifier checked operations against requested operations but did not inspect token claims for prohibited operations like DELETE, DROP, TRUNCATE, or ALTER.
remediationActions: Defined PROHIBITED_DESTRUCTIVE_OPERATIONS = ['DELETE', 'DROP', 'TRUNCATE', 'ALTER'].
Defined closed PERMITTED_OPERATIONS_ALLOWLIST = ['INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'UPSERT', 'SELECT'].
Verifier inspects all token operation grants and throws PROHIBITED_DESTRUCTIVE_OPERATION_IN_TOKEN if any destructive operation is present.
Rejects any operation outside allowlist with UNAUTHORIZED_OPERATION_GRANT.

defects.title: Table Scopes Omitted public.datasets and public.dataset_versions
defects.rootCause: Directive 142 allowlist listed only 6 tables for Stage 1, omitting datasets and dataset_versions modified by Migration 065.
remediationActions: Expanded ALL_AUTHORIZED_STAGING_TABLES to all 11 tables across the 4 stages (datasets, dataset_versions, provenance_records, political_organizations, organization_relationships, organization_multilingual_names, organization_symbols, organization_aliases, candidacies, constituency_demographics, election_results).
Verifier enforces that any token granting a table outside this closed set is rejected with UNAUTHORIZED_TABLE_GRANT.

defects.title: Credential Containment Gate Was String-Only Without Structured Incident Verification
defects.rootCause: Directive 142 verifier checked if incident_closure_ref was a non-empty string, without verifying the existence or content of an authorized administrative closure record.
remediationActions: Created scripts/lib/stagingAdminContainment.mjs implementing verifyAdminIncidentClosure().
Requires structured incident closure record confirming credentialRotated: true, accessLogsAudited: true, authorizedAdmin, certifiedAt, and targetProjectRef.
Fails closed with ADMIN_CONTAINMENT_UNCONFIRMED whenever the administrative record is missing or unverified, printing actionable prerequisites.
Execution halts before any transport invocation or network contact.

defects.title: Discrepancy Between Schema Table Names and Register/Executor Documentation
defects.rootCause: Reports referred to candidate_profiles, demographic_profiles, and historical_election_results, while actual migration schema uses candidacies, constituency_demographics, and election_results.
remediationActions: Reconciled all target table names across scripts and registers to match actual schema: public.candidacies, public.constituency_demographics, and public.election_results.
Reconciled Stage 1 to all 8 tables defined in Migration 065 (1,209 rows total).

Documented exact PostgREST conflict targets: candidacies (person_id,election_year,election_type,constituency_id), constituency_demographics (constituency_id,election_year), election_results (election_id,constituency_id).

defects.title: Stage Execution Did Not Handle Sequential Failure or Attach Partial Execution Report
defects.rootCause: If a downstream stage failed, earlier stage successes were not preserved in the report, and partial execution state was lost.
remediationActions: Implemented sequential stage execution with explicit try/catch blocks for each stage.
On stage failure, records earlier stages as EXECUTED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_CORROBORATION, current stage as FAILED, and downstream stages as SKIPPED_DUE_TO_PREVIOUS_FAILURE.
Sets executionStatus: PARTIAL_EXECUTION_FAILURE and attaches partial execution report to the thrown error.
Documents that consumed nonce prevents replay and requires a new token scoped to remaining unexecuted stages.

defects.title: Staging Service-Role Credential Rotation Remains Pending Administrative Confirmation
defects.rootCause: Staging Supabase project (fkpigozcqnmcvofuksar) credentials were exposed in prior sessions. While credentials were removed from code, live rotation in the Supabase console requires human administrator action.
remediationActions: Maintained 100% air-gap on production Supabase (ehfafcnimmjusyvplbah: 0 queries, 0 mutations).
Maintained operational gate on staging Supabase (fkpigozcqnmcvofuksar: 0 live queries, 0 live mutations).
Fail-closed verifier blocks all live staging execution until authenticated administrative closure record is provisioned.
Truthfully reported status as CONTAINMENT_PENDING_ADMIN_CONFIRMATION across all evidence artifacts.
defects.externalPrerequisite: Project Administrator confirmation of JWT secret rotation via Supabase dashboard on fkpigozcqnmcvofuksar and access-log audit.
